races.name: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is nearly always an informative newcomers event and Group-1 entrant DESERT CASTLE appeals most for a yard that has a good record in this. Farasan and Sommood are from stables that have their 2-y-os well forward so are feared most, though the market should prove to be informative.

  1. DESERT CASTLE
  2. FARASAN
  3. SOMMOOD

races.name: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Premium yearling OH SWEET ADARE can provide Charlie Appleby with another winning newcomer with Zarakova setting just an ordinary standard.

  1. OH SWEET ADARE (IRE)
  2. ZARAKOVA
  3. LILY PINK

races.name: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The 2 previous winners can fight this out, with NABATI preferred over Tawakal on the back of his narrow defeat in a listed contest at Newbury.

  1. NABATI (IRE)
  2. TAWAKAL (FR)
  3. AL WIDYAN

races.name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap
races.verdict:
FENLANDER proved very competitive when going for the 4-timer off this mark over C&D 3 weeks ago so remains of interest. Fiscal Policy and Fifty Nifty are in better form than recent form figures suggest, so they head the dangers.

  1. FENLANDER
  2. FISCAL POLICY (IRE)
  3. FIFTY NIFTY (IRE)

races.name: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
HILLTOP represents a yard in rude health at present and she can add another success for them here. The consistent Areti is expected to go well back in against handicap company, with Albeseeingyer another to consider.

  1. HILLTOP
  2. ARETI
  3. ALBESEEINGYER

races.name: Aspall Handicap
races.verdict:
LUCKY HERO improved when winning at Redcar recently and is taken to follow up from an unchanged mark. Blue Noon is reliable and rates the chief danger, ahead of hat-trick-seeking Shimmering Sands, who is up another 8 lb.

  1. LUCKY HERO (IRE)
  2. BLUE NOON (IRE)
  3. SHIMMERING SANDS

races.name: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap
races.verdict:
A final chance is given to RECON MISSION, who drops into a 0-55 for the first time in his career and Tony Carroll's veteran should be going very close if retaining any of his old enthusiasm. Diomed Spirit ran a cracker when runner-up at Windsor in June, so he could be the one to give the selection most to do, with Dreambird Dolly seemingly best of the rest.

  1. RECON MISSION (IRE)
  2. DIOMED SPIRIT
  3. DREAMBIRD DOLLY

races.name: JenningsBet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RED TAIL starts out in a very winnable maiden for Richard Hannon and could get the job done. Enamored is easily the pick of his rivals.

  1. RED TAIL (IRE)
  2. ENAMORED
  3. LITTLE MESTER

races.name: JenningsBet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
A lowly affair which can go the way of MYNA, who has made the frame on his last 4 outings and Tony Carroll's 5-y-o is more likely to give his running than most at this level. Thundering Breeze ran well on just her second start at this level at Lingfield back in February and she looks the main danger provided she's ready to roll on return.

  1. MYNA (IRE)
  2. THUNDERING BREEZE (IRE)
  3. DOGGED

races.name: Harry Bloom Memorial 'Brighton Bullet' Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several of these but the most persuasive is for MARCELLINUS, who has upped his game in handicaps this season and Tom Dascombe's 3-y-o is fancied to double his tally partnered by a promising 7-lb apprentice. U S S Charleston ran a cracker when runner-up in a big-field handicap at Glorious Goodwood last week, so he heads up the dangers down in grade, with Lequinto and Tenbob Tommy both in the mix for minor honours.

  1. MARCELLINUS
  2. U S S CHARLESTON
  3. LEQUINTO (IRE)

races.name: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With JenningsBet Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint which can go the way of DRAGON GOD, who finally opened his account at Yarmouth on Sunday and Tony Carroll's 4-y-o looks capable of following up under a 5-lb penalty. Mart was a couple of places behind the selection that day and he looks to be the one to offer most resistance, with last-time-out winners Manhattan Chute and Bated Breeze taken to fight out third.

  1. DRAGON GOD
  2. MART
  3. MANHATTAN CHUTE (IRE)

races.name: Bet Responsibly With JenningsBet Handicap
races.verdict:
A tricky finale to solve with the vote going to ARVANA BELLE, who was never in it upped to 1m at Salisbury last time but is better judged on her previous Leicester third. Pennine Way produced her best effort when third at Wolverhampton recently, so she looks the biggest threat if able to translate that form back to turf, with Shes Got The Blues seemingly best of the rest.

  1. ARVANA BELLE (IRE)
  2. PENNINE WAY
  3. SHES GOT THE BLUES (IRE)

races.name: Al Nujaifi Racing Series Fillies & Mares Conditions Stakes - Arab Race
goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
TARLAC isn't the easiest of conveyances, but he sets the standard following a close second at Hamilton last time. Tickets is most likely to expose any chinks in his armour, while Hurstwood is another credible danger.

  1. TARLAC (IRE)
  2. TICKETS
  3. HURSTWOOD

races.name: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive maiden that may go the way of improving INGLEWOOD. My Maria and Travellers Girl both hold solid claims, while Time Glory would be interesting if back on song. Veruca Salt and Estella Havisham are a couple to note for support.

  1. INGLEWOOD
  2. MY MARIA (IRE)
  3. TIME GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
Recent all-the-way winner GERRY'S DARLING may be able to repeat the feat on nursery debut. Love Tanya and Bymiddaytomorrow were both relatively expensive purchases and could well have more to offer.

  1. GERRY'S DARLING
  2. LOVE TANYA (IRE)
  3. BYMIDDAYTOMORROW (IRE)

races.name: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap
races.verdict:
AZUINTHEJUNGLE may record a hat-trick for the second successive season. Military Girl is feared most, though J Street and Glory Fighter also need considering in a trappy sprint.

  1. AZUINTHEJUNGLE
  2. MILITARY GIRL (IRE)
  3. J STREET

races.name: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A tricky puzzle. Hopefully there's enough pace on for the returning SUDU, who should have gone close on reappearance last year. Master Vintner could be dangerous if first-time blinkers have the desired effect.

  1. SUDU
  2. MASTER VINTNER (IRE)
  3. MAJESTIC (IRE)

races.name: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap
races.verdict:
GREAT PROFIT has been knocking on the door and is fancied to gain a breakthrough success. Maximum Velocity has less to prove than most and may again take silver.

  1. GREAT PROFIT (IRE)
  2. MAXIMUM VELOCITY (IRE)
  3. LOPE Y LINDA

races.name: Zyn Pole Position EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ANCESTOR had some useful types behind him when winning at Yarmouth and looks up to giving the weight away to Tropical Sands, who has shown promise on both starts but will likely need to advance her form a good bit to seriously trouble the selection.

  1. ANCESTOR
  2. TROPICAL SANDS
  3. GOLDEN CAVIAR (IRE)

races.name: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
In an amateur riders race where a case can be made for most it might be worth chancing EDWARD SEXTON, who should be more than capable of winning off a mark of 65 based on his bumper ability. His handicap debut in this sphere came over an inadequate 1¼m on all-weather and he can prove a different proposition over a much longer trip on his first turf start on the level. Arrange can fill the forecast spot, with Fast Fred and Made All others likely to get involved in the battle for minor honours.

  1. EDWARD SEXTON (IRE)
  2. ARRANGE (IRE)
  3. FAST FRED

races.name: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery
races.verdict:
The form of CASINO STAR's latest Hamilton near miss was boosted when the winner was placed in Group 3 company at Goodwood last week and Karl Burke's charge is taken to strike on nursery debut. God Given Talent is interesting down in grade on his first run for William Haggas and is second choice ahead of Rotelle, who can have a line put through his latest Newcastle effort and remains capable of better.

  1. CASINO STAR (IRE)
  2. GOD GIVEN TALENT (IRE)
  3. ROTELLE

races.name: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARTHURIAN gets the nod to build on his opening effort in a normally-strong Newbury novice but strong market support for one of the newcomers, the most eyecatching of whom is Karl Burke's Burning Up, would put a slightly different slant on things.

  1. ARTHURIAN
  2. BURNING UP
  3. GOLDEN FALCON (IRE)

races.name: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SYNDICALE did very well to overcome significant greenness on her Wolverhampton debut and is selected to give the weight away. Silver Sovereign rates an obvious danger after her opening Salisbury second, while Freshwater didn't really get a chance to show what she could do on her Catterick debut, with her 2/1 SP suggesting she'd been showing up well at home.

  1. SYNDICALE (IRE)
  2. SILVER SOVEREIGN
  3. FRESHWATER

races.name: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap
races.verdict:
TOKYO JOE held on from 2 next-time-out winners at Ffos Las in July so looks well treated off just 1 lb higher. Distinct Spirit races off the same mark as when successful at Lingfield last weekend so he's another likely to go well. Invincible Ruby and Farandaway complete the shortlist.

  1. TOKYO JOE
  2. DISTINCT SPIRIT
  3. INVINCIBLE RUBY (IRE)

races.name: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of MINERS GAMBLE, who wasn't beaten far despite meeting trouble when fifth at Newcastle 13 days ago. He can build on that effort to gain a second C&D victory, though Falcon Nine is much respected in his bid to win this race for a second year running, with Samra Star another to consider.

  1. MINERS GAMBLE (IRE)
  2. FALCON NINE
  3. SAMRA STAR (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting small-field novice. MINSTER MAN producing a promising first effort behind a heavily-backed one at Yarmouth just over a fortnight ago and is taken to make the most of the 8 lb he receives from Barnaby Rudge, who still showed signs of inexperience when beating one now rated 96 by Timeform at Newcastle last time. Faith In Florence also seems sure to be winning races before long.

  1. MINSTER MAN (IRE)
  2. BARNABY RUDGE (IRE)
  3. FAITH IN FLORENCE (IRE)

races.name: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
BIGALO has a progressive profile and having only been beaten ½-length by Bluestone Lady over C&D last week, he's expected to reverse the form with that rival on 3 lb better terms and open his account. Bella Lucia is bred to appreciate this longer trip on nursery debut and warrants respect.

  1. BIGALO
  2. BLUESTONE LADY (IRE)
  3. BELLA LUCIA

races.name: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
GWEEDORE hasn't been at his best so far this season, but he's now 7 lb lower in the weights than for his last success here in November. With blinkers applied, it would be no surprise to see him land a sixth C&D win, at the expense of the hat-trick seeking Eagle Bay who hasn't been done any favours by the draw. Augustus Gloop completes the shortlist.

  1. GWEEDORE
  2. EAGLE BAY
  3. AUGUSTUS GLOOP

races.name: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap
races.verdict:
WOOHOO has been running consistently well with second-place finishes on her last 4 outings, going close when first home in her group at Goodwood, and she looks ready to resume winning ways this time around. Montezuma helps to give Jim Goldie a strong hand in the race, while Tiva could also be in the mix.

  1. WOOHOO (IRE)
  2. MONTEZUMA
  3. TIVA (IRE)

races.name: Brodie Handicap
races.verdict:
ROC DE FER has left his previous form behind upped in trip the last twice, making it back-to-back wins when defying a penalty at Wolverhampton, and he can continue his progress to score again. He is taken to confirm the placings with Much from when the pair met a week ago, with Sure And Stedfast the pick of the remainder.

  1. ROC DE FER (IRE)
  2. MUCH
  3. SURE AND STEDFAST (IRE)

races.name: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for MISEMERALD, who looked unlucky not to win after meeting trouble over this C&D 7 days ago. With Monhammer carrying a penalty the placings from last week could be reversed and they look the pair to focus on, though Keep Me Stable is one to note back down in grade.

  1. MISEMERALD (IRE)
  2. MONHAMMER
  3. KEEP ME STABLE (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
PRINCESS CHLOE has fared much better switched to turf on her last 2 starts, caught further back than ideal when a never-nearer fourth over C&D last time, and she can build on those efforts to get off the mark. Rock Iguana showed fairly useful form in Britain and is feared most on stable debut, ahead of Inishfallen.

  1. PRINCESS CHLOE (IRE)
  2. ROCK IGUANA (IRE)
  3. INISHFALLEN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
MALLAVELLY ran up to her best when beaten only by a thriving rival at the Curragh in June and, having gone nicely through the race on her latest outing, she is taken to get back to winning ways returned to this shorter trip. Hasita could be the main danger as she goes back up in distance, with Rebel Wave also considered.

  1. MALLAVELLY (IRE)
  2. HASITA (IRE)
  3. REBEL WAVE (IRE)

races.name: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant TOKYO TREASURE remains with potential so is taken to open his account with the benefit of a favourable draw. Neo Smart is on a handy mark and can make her presence felt, while it would be no surprise to see Alfred Tennyson take a hand in the finish also.

  1. TOKYO TREASURE (IRE)
  2. NEO SMART (IRE)
  3. ALFRED TENNYSON (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
SUNRISE ANGEL shaped with more encouragement last time and may well build on that to open his account. Several have chances of making the places with handicap debutant Kingcharles and Gilts heading the main dangers.

  1. SUNRISE ANGEL (IRE)
  2. KINGCHARLES (FR)
  3. GILTS (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
An interesting juvenile race despite only the 6 runners with preference for SERGEI DIAGHILEV, who surely has more to offer up in trip. Venetian Power is clearly well thought of, though may have to settle for second best, with the once-raced City of Dubai perhaps the one to see out the 1-2-3.

  1. SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE)
  2. VENETIAN POWER (IRE)
  3. CITY OF DUBAI (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race
races.verdict:
BENEVENTO may well have needed the outing on first start for this yard when third here recently and now returned to 1m, he's fancied to belatedly add to his pair of juvenile wins having been ambitiously campaigned last year. Joseph O'Brien saddles a couple of interesting runners and his Celtic Motif heads up the opposition, with Rahmi rounding off the shortlist provided he keeps his quirks in check.

  1. BENEVENTO (IRE)
  2. CELTIC MOTIF (IRE)
  3. RAHMI (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant FORTHILL is in excellent hands and could be very interesting if revitalised by a first-time visor. Vervain, Numidia, Ms Messi and L'Un Deux Trois all have claims in an open-looking finale.

  1. FORTHILL (FR)
  2. VERVAIN (IRE)
  3. NUMIDIA (IRE)

races.name: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TOMTHESCAFFOLDER promised even better for a long way when third in a 2½m maiden at Wexford last month, so is selected to open his account with the drop in trip likely to suit. Sea Eagle and Penny Express are considered the chief threats.

  1. TOMTHESCAFFOLDER
  2. SEA EAGLE
  3. PENNY EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
A big field but it's hard to get away from top-weight CHOSEN SHANT, who won this corresponding race last year and has been in top form over fences here in recent weeks. She can enhance a fine track record at the expense of Avandra, who is a long-standing maiden but is going through a good spell. Annarubyrose and Tropical Twist are another couple who may feature.

  1. CHOSEN SHANT (IRE)
  2. AVANDRA (IRE)
  3. ANNARUBYROSE (IRE)

races.name: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SHABOOZEE looked firmly on the up over hurdles last season and is taken to make a winning return for a yard still in excellent order. Jabbar has a bit to find on form but is consistent and gets the benefit of a good-value conditional, so rates the main danger, while Mode Avion is also respected.

  1. SHABOOZEE (IRE)
  2. JABBAR (IRE)
  3. MODE AVION (FR)

races.name: SIS Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
SET THE TONE won over this C&D 15 days ago and is selected to defy a 6 lb rise for an in-form yard. Gerrys Wish is a consistent sort and looks sure to again give his running, whilst Charlie's Dilemma has the services of a good-value conditional and is also respected.

  1. SET THE TONE (IRE)
  2. GERRYS WISH (IRE)
  3. CHARLIE'S DILEMMA (IRE)

races.name: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DEISE CRYSTAL still has an air of untapped potential and is worth chancing now stepping back up in trip. Bayonetta is consistent and had a genuine excuse for underperforming last time, so rates the main danger, while Hob's Angel arrives on the back of a solid placed effort at this course.

  1. DEISE CRYSTAL
  2. BAYONETTA (IRE)
  3. HOB'S ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
POPPYCON has been knocking on the door since switched to handicaps. He had a next-time-out winner behind in third when runner-up at Sligo last time and is selected to make light of top weight. Las Brisas Boy is another who arrives on the back of a good second at Sligo, while Chosen Princess and Ballyminnion Boy have the profiles of potential improvers in handicaps.

  1. POPPYCON (IRE)
  2. LAS BRISAS BOY (IRE)
  3. CHOSEN PRINCESS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
SHUIL SOLAS shaped encouragingly from an unpromising position on her debut at Roscommon (2m) last month and seems sure to build on that opening effort, especially with a more experienced amateur now taking over in the saddle, so she earns the vote. Newcomer Pat O's Rock makes plenty of appeal on paper and needs keeping a close eye on in the betting, while Get It Girl and Royal Tiara are others firmly in the mix.

  1. SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
  2. PAT O'S ROCK (IRE)
  3. GET IT GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Quai Au Coq Maiden Stakes
Prix Du Chemin De L'hippodrome Handicap
Prix Du Garage L'atelier Rouxmesnil (prix Lands End) Hurdle
Prix A+ Glass Rouxmesnil (prix Remy Mouquet) Hurdle
Prix Ministere Du Bon Esprit Handicap Chase
Prix Mon Controle Technique Rouxmesnil Handicap Hurdle
Prix Societe Nouvelle Abraham Depannage (prix Arenice) Handicap Chase
Prix Mika Motor Location (prix D'angers - Chmpt Paris Turf Des Ajj) Hurdle
Prix Qg Nautic Martin-eglise (prix Le Roi Thibault) Chase
